sources.desc:
True Automation PACS Appraisal Export: fixed-width text tables (two are tab-separated), parsed to CSV by denton_appraisal_export_etl.ipynb with the PACS 8.0.30 field positions in pacs_appraisal_export_layout.json. Unlike the JSON export, each supplement is published here, so this is where roll corrections show up; the Correction changes tab summarises them. Each export has its own button above the file list; columns new since the previous export are tagged new, and each file notes the rows added, removed and changed.
  • 2026 certified · Jul 27: supplement 0, run 07/27/2026 07:00, PACS 8.1.33.23, export version 8.0.0.33 (Data/2026 CERTIFIED DATA - ALL PROPERTIES/)
  • 2026 supplement 3 · Oct 14: supplement 3, run 10/14/2026 12:18, PACS 8.1.33.23, export version 8.0.0.33 (Data/2026-3/)
